Apple has removed the DVDPlayback framework from the macOS 27 SDK, so developers can no longer build apps against it with that SDK. items.summary: Apple didn't make some weird, proprietary connector or power system for Apple HomeView , but instead relied on USB-C. Apple HomeView can be portable with a battery pack A lot of the early rumors around Apple HomeView made it sound like a portable display . At one point it was even suggested that they would be carried around by multiple users in a home instead of being bolted in place. The product Apple announced was the opposite in nearly every aspect. items.summary: Multi-million dollar sale comes despite a federal judge in Hawaii voiding the environmental clearance it had been given to proceed The US has carried out its first ever deep-sea mining lease sales off the coast of American Samoa, despite an adverse court ruling earlier this week and mounting local opposition. The sales took place on Thursday in a live-streamed auction of 12.7m hectares (31.5m acres) of seabed off the US territory’s coast marked for mineral exploration. items.summary: Token fraud is here and it’s BAD (YouTube) Claire Vo runs ChatPRD , an AI platform that helps product managers "turn an idea into a spec". The product has been live since the GPT-4 era, and Claire has been building it in public for much of that time. In this YouTube video (see also the accompanying Twitter post ) Claire describes the flood of token fraud she has seen from groups abusing the product's free trial, sometimes just to get free AI usage but often to resell tokens or run other commercial enterprises on top of the ChatPRD agent. I am funding a international Roblox and Fortnite map studio. They run a loop of free trials and promo codes and then tunnel to my agent and use it to build Roblox and Fortnite maps.
